location.where: Results, Adrenal Axis - Cortisol paragraph (planned contrasts)
location.quote: cortisol levels were significantly higher at 16:00 on SR5 (mean ± SEM; 247.1±21.9) than B1 (179.0±16.6

reported.what: blood glucose on B1 and SR5, mean +/- SE over the sampling day as printed in the text (mixed-model means, Table 1 note)

location.where: Results, Glucose Metabolism - Glucose, Insulin and Triglycerides, paragraph on glucose
location.quote: Glucose was 11.4% higher after sleep restriction (mean ± SE; 5.5±0.1) than at baseline (4.9±0.1)

reported.what: serum insulin on B1 and SR5, mean +/- SE over the sampling day as printed in the text

location.where: Results, Glucose, Insulin and Triglycerides section, paragraph on insulin
location.quote: Insulin was 28.8% higher after sleep restriction (mean ± SE: 44.2±4.2 uU/ml) than at baseline (34.4±2.8)

reported.what: leptin on B1 and SR5, mean +/- SE over the sampling day as printed in the text

location.quote: Leptin was 13.7% higher after sleep restriction (mean ± SE: 4.8±0.4 ng/ml) than at baseline (4.3±0.3)

reported.what: daily energy intake on B1 and SR5, mean +/- SD, and its carbohydrate share on B1, as day totals with no meal split

location.quote: Average caloric intake (mean ± SD) was 1973.0±31.9 kcal on B1 and 1961.8±30.9 kcal on SR5. Carbohydrates accounted for 52.9%±2.2% of caloric intake on B1

detail: The lab meals are printed only as day totals (energy and macronutrient percentages) with no grams per meal and no split of the day among breakfast, lunch and dinner, so the grams cannot be placed at the meal times (09:00, 13:00, 18:30 by the Figure 3 legend) that every B1 and SR5 sample after the fasting draw depends on; the SR5 samples also need the five restricted nights and their meals (a prior_day_condition), and the 09:00 fasting draws are given only as figure bars, so no value can be written.
